analysis.title: TransDigm Group (TDG): F4Q26 First Take: Strong qtr; issued FY27 revenue and EBITDA guide above consensus
key_insights: TDG reported F4Q26 revenue, EBITDA and adjusted EPS ahead of consensus, on organic sales growth of 14% and a 53.0% EBITDA margin.
Commercial aftermarket grew 15% y/y (17% last quarter), commercial OEM grew 17% (17% last quarter) and defense grew 12% (11% last quarter).
Within commercial, transport aftermarket/OEM grew 16% and 25%, and bizjet/helicopter aftermarket/OEM grew 21% and was flat y/y.
Initial FY27 guidance has revenue of $11.95-$12.15bn and EBITDA as defined of $6.195-$6.345bn, both above FactSet consensus at the midpoint or range.
FY27 adjusted EPS guidance of $47.09-$47.94 is below FactSet consensus of $48.72. GS says the company likely accounts for higher net interest expense, with guided interest expense of about $2,255mn.
Versus GS's own estimates, adjusted EPS was $0.08 below ($12.44 vs $12.52). Commercial OEM revenue missed GS by 6.1%, commercial aftermarket beat by 3.9% and defense matched.
Reported EPS of $10.33 missed GS's $11.23, driven by D&A of $122mn vs $80mn estimated, $147mn of total adjustments vs $85mn, and a $50mn other loss vs none estimated.
GS rates TDG Buy with a 12-month price target of $1,745, based on 20.0x CY27E EV/EBITDA, implying 43.2% upside from the $1,218.85 close on 9 Nov 2026.

market_movers.rationale: GS keeps its Buy and $1,745 target after a quarter that beat consensus, with FY27 revenue and EBITDA guidance above consensus. The target uses 20.0x CY27E EV/EBITDA.

earnings_insights: F4Q26 adjusted EPS of $12.44 reported vs FactSet consensus of $12.21 (reported 11/10), and vs GS estimate of $12.52. Reported (GAAP) EPS was $10.33 vs GS estimate $11.23, and $7.75 in F4Q25.
F4Q26 total sales of $2,988mn reported vs GS estimate of $2,976mn, up 22.6% y/y on reported basis. Organic growth was 14%.
F4Q26 EBITDA as defined of $1.58bn reported vs FactSet consensus of $1.55bn. Margin was 53.0% reported vs consensus of 52.6%, and 54.1% in F4Q25.

FY27 guidance (issued 11/10): revenue $11.95-$12.15bn (FactSet consensus est $11.78bn), EBITDA as defined $6.195-$6.345bn (FactSet consensus est $6.182bn), adjusted EPS $47.09-$47.94 (FactSet consensus est $48.72), GAAP EPS $42.06-$42.91, EBITDA margin 51.8-52.2%.

FY27 organic growth guidance is commercial OEM up high-single-digit to low-double-digit %, commercial aftermarket up high-single-digit %, and defense up high-single-digit %. Other guided items are net income $2,442-$2,490mn, tax rate about 22-24%, weighted shares 56.7mn and capex $365-$395mn.
GS estimates for TDG: FY26E revenue $10,545.5mn, EBITDA $5,249.1mn, EPS $41.40. FY27E revenue $12,175.8mn, EBITDA $6,260.5mn, EPS $52.33.
risk_factors: Key risks named by GS are aftermarket growth, acquisition integration and defense spending.
Higher net interest expense weighs on FY27 EPS guidance relative to consensus, with guided interest expense of about $2,255mn.
Commercial OEM revenue was 6.1% below GS's estimate in F4Q26.
